# n8n_workflow_version (Data Source)

Fetches a specific version of an n8n workflow from workflow history.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version_id` (String) Version identifier for the specific workflow snapshot
- `workflow_id` (String) Workflow identifier

### Read-Only

- `authors` (String) Authors who created this version
- `connections_json` (String) Workflow connections as a JSON string at this version
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when this version was created
- `name` (String) Workflow name at this version
- `nodes_json` (String) Workflow nodes as a JSON string at this version
